Tests compute budget parsing, fee calculation, overflow, and duplicate instruction handling.

# Purpose
This file is a C test program for the `fd_compute_budget_program` parser and finalizer. It loads several binary transaction fixtures with `FD_IMPORT_BINARY`, parses each transaction, scans its instructions for compute budget program calls, and checks the computed maximum compute units, fee in lamports, and loaded account data cost against expected values. The [`test_duplicate`](<#test_duplicate>) function checks how the parser handles repeated compute budget instructions and verifies which combinations are accepted or rejected. [`main`](<#main>) runs the test cases, checks edge cases for fee calculation and overflow handling, and ends with a pass message when all tests succeed.
